subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Postpartum haemorrhage: atony, trauma, tissue and thrombin

steps.tx: **PPH** (**500 ml vaginal**, **1000 ml section**, severe 1000 with shock; **atony** overcontracted uterus, **trauma** tears, **tissue** retained, **thrombin** DIC) kills fastest; **active third stage** (**oxytocin 10 IU IM**, controlled cord traction, uterine massage) prevents. Quantified drapes weigh; shock index tachycardia hypotension transfuses. Grand multiparity twins polyhydramnios macrosomia atony risk.
steps.say: Half litre vaginal litre section is PPH: oxytocin 10 IM active third prevents. Four Ts find.

steps.tx: **Oxytocin** (**10 IU IM** prevention, **20 to 40 IU infusion** treatment, bolus hypotension) with **ergometrine** (**hypertension banned**, nausea) and **carboprost** (**asthma banned**, diarrhoea fever) then **misoprostol** (800 sublingual, shivering fever) sequences; **tranexamic acid** (**1 g IV within 3 hours**, WOMAN trial) clots early. Bimanual compression bridges; aorta compresses.
steps.say: Oxytocin first ergometrine hypertensive banned carboprost asthmatic banned: tranexamic grams 3 hours. Sequence squeezes.

steps.tx: **Balloon tamponade** (**Bakri**, condom catheter low resource, 24 hours with antibiotics) with **B-Lynch compression suture**, uterine artery ligation, **internal iliac** then **hysterectomy** last resort steps; **retained tissue** (succenturiate lobe, velamentous vessels) explores manually. Placenta accreta spectrum (previa with sections, bladder invasion MRI) hysterectomises electively.
steps.say: Balloon day B-Lynch stitch artery ties hysterectomy last: retained explores. Accreta previa sections hysterectomises.

steps.tx: **DIC** (abruption, amniotic embolism, sepsis, massive transfusion dilution; **fibrinogen** cryoprecipitate, **1:1:1** red cells plasma platelets, calcium warmed) with **transfusion** (O negative emergency, tranexamic early, cell salvage) resuscitates; **uterine inversion** (**Johnson manoeuvre**, relaxants then oxytocics, shock out of proportion) reinverts urgently. Thromboelastometry guides; audit every PPH.
steps.say: DIC fibrinogen cries 1:1:1 warmed calcium: inversion Johnson reinverts shock disproportionate. Audit closes.
